직접 가지 못한 분들을 위해

snippet.title: 김완선 작가 뉴욕 전시 퍼포먼스 미리보기

[ENG SUB] [최초공개] 김완선, 뉴욕 전시장 보고 충격받은 이유 | #bypdc
snippet.description:
#김완선 #미국 #뉴욕 #USA #브이로그 #Kpop

여러분 😊
드디어 완선언니와 뉴욕에 도착했습니다!!!!
서울은 봄이 왔는데 뉴욕은 아직 추운 겨울이었어요 ㅠㅠ 

도착하자마자 언니의 작품이 걸려있는 Tenri center 로 향했습니다
뉴욕 맨하탄은 택시를 타는거보다 걷는게 낫다고 
해서 걸어가기로 했죠 
여기서 완선 언니의 반전 매력 등장
길을 진짜 못 찾는 거예요….하아….
어떻게 찾아갔는지 영상에서 공개합니다ㅎㅎ

근데 더 놀라운 건 전시장 안에서였어요!
본인 작품이 전시된 모습을 처음 보는 순간, 
저는 당황했는데 언니가 너무 좋아하더라구요
캔버스 틀을 떼고 걸려진 그림들
선입견을 깨버린 전시… 힙한 뉴욕이기에 가능한…
거기서 세계적인 작가 선생님과 전시 관계자분들까지 다들 극찬에 극찬을 해주시는데
그걸 듣는 완선 언니 모습… 진짜 찡했어요ㅠㅠ

전시장을 나오니 비와 눈이 내리는데 
폴짝폴짝 뛰며 좋아하는거 있죠
이런 모습은 정말 저도 처음 봤다니까요~ 

아마 쉅게보지못한 귀한 영상일 거에요 ㅎㅎ

드디어 전시 오프닝날 
뉴욕에서 완선 언니의 40년 인연인 1호 팬 ‘케빈’도
응원하러 왔어요

그당시 ‘김완선’, ‘소방차’, ‘박남정’이 1등을 차지 하기위한 팬클럽과의 이야기와 완선언니도 기억하지 못하는 ‘둘이서 콩국수 먹다가 매니저 이모한테 불려가서 크게 혼쭐난 사연’
그때로 돌아가 두사람의 추억이야기가 꽤 흥미로웠어요

과연 완선언니가 기대하고 기대했던 이번 전시에 얼마나 많은 관람객들이 왔을까요? 
국장님들도 궁금하시죠?

en.description:
Hi everyone!

This video follows Kim Wan-sun—not as a singer, but as an artist opening her first solo exhibition in New York.

We headed straight to the gallery after landing, only to discover she’s hilariously bad with directions! You’ll have to watch to see how we actually made it there.

The real shock came inside. Seeing her unframed canvases perfectly complement the space left her stunned. Witnessing world-class artists and curators shower her with praise was truly moving. 
Stay tuned for a rare glimpse of her literally skipping through the streets of New York afterward it was too cute!

On opening day, we met Kevin, her "No. 1 Fan" for 40 years. 
He shares an exclusive story about getting in trouble over a bowl of noodles, plus the inside scoop on the legendary '80s fan rivalries with Sobangcha and Park Nam-jung.

Curious about the turnout for her big debut?

Follow us to the gallery!

en-US.description:
#KimWanSun #USA #NewYork #USA #Vlog #Kpop

Everyone 😊

We finally arrived in New York with Wan-sun!!!!

Spring has arrived in Seoul, but it was still a cold winter in New York ㅠㅠ

As soon as we arrived, we headed to the Tenri Center where her artwork was hanging.

They said it's better to walk than take a taxi in Manhattan, New York, so we decided to walk.

Here comes Wan-sun's unexpected charm.

She really can't find her way... *Sigh*...

I'll reveal how we found it in the video haha.

But what was even more surprising was inside the exhibition!

The moment I saw her own work displayed for the first time,

I was flustered, but

Wan-sun loved it so much.

Paintings hung without their canvas frames.

An exhibition that shattered preconceptions... something only possible in hip New York...

There, world-renowned artists and exhibition staff all showered her with praise,

and the look on Wan-sun's face as she listened to it... It really touched my heart.

When we left the exhibition hall, it was raining and snowing, but she was jumping up and down with joy.

I honestly have never seen her like this before!

It’s probably a precious video that you don’t get to see often. Haha.

Finally, on the day of the exhibition opening, Kevin, Wan-sun’s number one fan and a 40-year friend from New York, also came to cheer her on.

It was quite interesting to hear the stories of the fan clubs competing for first place back then—Kim Wan-sun, Sobangcha, and Park Nam-jung—and the story of how they got called over by the manager and scolded severely while eating soybean noodle soup, a story Wan-sun doesn’t even remember.

I wonder how many visitors actually came to this exhibition that Wan-sun has been looking forward to so much?

Directors, you’re curious too, aren’t you?
